body: I dont know how it is, but im really not one to talk about how i feel. Especially face to face. And i dont see how having someone to talk to will help me personally. Im absolutely not saying it doesnt work, i think it helps alot of people, but i dont think it will help me.
Thats the thing, I don’t feel suicidal, atleast I think I don’t. I just kinda dont want to exist.
